## Summary

I fixed the `format_inr` function in `/tmp/h-bug_grouping-docqrj1e/invoicing/money.py` by changing the while loop condition on line 24 from `while len(head) > 3:` to `while len(head) > 2:`.

**The issue**: The function was grouping digits incorrectly for Indian numbering. After splitting off the rightmost 3 digits, it needed to group remaining digits in pairs, but the loop would exit too early when the remaining digits equaled exactly 3.

**The fix**: The corrected condition ensures digits are properly grouped in pairs until only 2 or fewer remain for the leftmost group. Now `12345678 paise` correctly formats to `"₹1,23,456.78"` instead of `"₹123,456.78"`.

**Tests**: All 10 tests pass. ✅
